hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "Running ruff before commit..." >&2; cd "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd")" && ruff check src/ --fix >&2 && ruff format src/ >&2 || { echo "{\"decision\": \"block\", \"reason\": \"ruff check/format failed. Fix lint errors before committing.\"}"; exit 0; }; fi; echo "{\"decision\": \"approve\"}"'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.py$"; then DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); cd "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd")" && ruff check "$FILE" --fix --quiet 2>&1 && ruff format "$FILE" --quiet 2>&1; fi; echo "{\"decision\": \"approve\"}"'

bash -c 'echo "=== Clinkz session context ==="; echo; echo "Current branch: $(git branch --show-current)"; echo; echo "Last 3 commits:"; git log --oneline -3; echo; echo "Uncommitted changes:"; git diff --stat | tail -5; echo; echo "Test suite health:"; pytest tests/ -q --tb=no 2>&1 | tail -3 || echo "(pytest not yet run this session)"; echo; echo "v2 agents present:"; ls src/clinkz/agents/*.py 2>/dev/null | grep -v __init__ | xargs -n1 basename; echo; echo "Read these for full context: CLAUDE.md, CLINKZ_V2_IMPLEMENTATION.md"'
